parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry is_test=true and reside in Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistFetcherTests.swift. The two methods — fetchPlaylistReturnsEmptyOnURLError (line 65) and fetchPlaylistReturnsEmptyOnCancellationError (line 103) — are deliberately distinct test cases that exercise different error paths (URLError vs. CancellationError); their structural similarity (Jaccard 0.73) reflects the shared test scaffold pattern, not unintentional duplication. Merging or extracting them would obscure the distinct failure modes each test is meant to document and would couple test semantics in a way that reduces diagnostic clarity.
